svg.title: graph-age architecture
svg.desc: Architecture diagram for the graph-age module showing graph-core contracts, AGE operations adapters, SQL execution through Exposed and HikariCP, agtype parsing, PostgreSQL AGE storage, and JVM algorithm fallbacks.
svg.text: Apache AGE adapter: graph-core contracts become Cypher-over-SQL, Exposed JDBC transactions, and agtype model mapping.
AGE schema DDL is intentionally unsupported here; createIndex fails explicitly instead of pretending to be portable.
